full_prompt_en: A square, richly colored screen-print-style illustration shows a young woman in right-facing profile, her pale olive-green face surrounded by flowing deep teal hair and a brilliant orange patterned background. The close composition crops the top of her hair and much of her shoulders, allowing the head to command nearly the whole frame. Across the upper left, thick waves of blue-green hair sweep toward the center in many fine parallel curves. At the brow and eye, dark precise outlines frame a turquoise iris, long lashes, and a quiet sideways gaze. A small dark nostril and sharply defined nose bridge lead to orange-red lips. A thin brown cigarette extends horizontally from her mouth toward the right edge, with a small gray tip; no large smoke cloud is visible. Soft gray-green shadow under the cheek and jaw gives the otherwise graphic face subtle volume. Beneath the chin, more teal curls loop over a dark garment, and orange-yellow foliage-like fragments fill the lower left. On the right, decorative turquoise currents curl across a mottled yellow-orange ground, breaking it into irregular shapes. Near the lower right edge, small distant blocky structures appear against a lighter patch, but they remain subordinate to the close profile and the moving color. Fine cross-lines, stippling, and worn ink-like grain cover the colored regions, giving the smooth facial plane and richly patterned surroundings a shared printed surface. The scene is lit as an illustration through deliberate light and dark color fields rather than a realistic single lamp; the face remains the brightest large shape, framed by dark hair and warm ground. Crisp black contours define the eye, mouth, and hair strands, while the surrounding ornament has more irregular edges. There is no readable lettering. The overall composition is dense, warm-cool, and rhythmic, contrasting a still profile with vigorous flowing lines and distressed decorative color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、色彩浓厚的丝网印刷风格插画呈现一名面朝右侧的年轻女子，浅橄榄绿面孔被流动的深青色头发和明亮的橙色图案背景包围。贴近的构图裁掉部分头发顶部和大半肩膀，使头部占据几乎整个画幅。左上方，厚重的蓝绿色发浪以许多细密平行曲线向中央扫来。眉眼处的精确深色轮廓框住青绿虹膜、长睫毛与安静的侧向目光。小小的深色鼻孔和清晰鼻梁通向橙红色嘴唇。一根细棕色香烟从嘴间水平伸向右缘，末端带一点灰色；看不到大片烟雾。脸颊和下颌下方柔和的灰绿色阴影给图形化面孔一点微妙体积。下巴下面更多青绿色卷发盘旋于深色衣服之上，橙黄色近似枝叶的碎片填满左下。右侧，装饰性的青绿曲流卷过斑驳黄橙色地面，把它分割成不规则形状。靠近右下边缘，一些远处的块状结构出现在较浅色区域前，但从属于近处侧脸与流动色彩。细密交叉线、点彩和磨旧的墨色颗粒覆盖各处着色区域，使平滑脸部色面与丰富图案环境共享印刷表面。场景的光由有意安排的明暗色块表现，而非写实单一灯源；面孔仍是最大的亮形，被深发和暖色底场框住。清晰黑色轮廓定义眼睛、嘴和发丝，周围纹样的边缘则更加不规则。没有可读文字。整体构图密集、冷暖对照且有节奏，以静止的侧脸对比有力的流动线条和磨旧的装饰色彩。
style_prompt_en: The screen-print-like illustration uses saturated complementary areas of deep turquoise and warm orange, moderated by olive green, ocher, and dark ink. Flat colored planes gain depth from fine hatching, stipple, distressed pigment, and a few soft tonal shadows rather than smooth digital gradients. Long parallel curves sweep across shorter irregular motifs, producing a strong directional flow around a simpler luminous focal plane. Dark outlines sharpen selected details, while patterned fields have broken, weathered edges and can interlock without a clear boundary. Dense ornament covers most of the square, yet changes in scale and a large quieter area keep the composition legible. Warm and cool colors meet at high contrast, making both seem more vivid; small black intervals prevent the surface from becoming uniformly bright. The overall effect is ornate, psychedelic, and tactile, with graphic stillness held inside energetic linear movement.
style_prompt_zh: 这种近似丝网印刷的插画使用深青绿与暖橙色的大面积饱和互补色，再用橄榄绿、赭黄和深墨色调和。平坦色面通过细排线、点彩、磨损颜料和少数柔和明暗阴影获得纵深，而非依靠平滑数字渐层。长而平行的曲线扫过较短的不规则纹样，在更简洁的明亮焦点色面周围形成强烈方向流动。深色轮廓强化选中的细节，图案色域则有破损、风化的边缘，也可在没有明确分界时相互咬合。密集装饰覆盖方形画面的多数部分，不过尺度变化和一大片较安静的区域保持构图清楚。暖冷颜色高反差相遇，让彼此显得更加鲜明；小块黑色间隔避免表面通体明亮。整体效果华丽、迷幻且可触，在充满活力的线性运动中稳住图形的静止感。
theme_en: A green-toned woman in profile against swirling turquoise and orange decoration
theme_zh: 橙色与青绿旋纹前一名绿色调侧脸女子
name: Chuck Sperry
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
